entities.summary: Penina Muhando (b. 1948-03-03, Kilosa) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kilosa and Tanzania. Known in the fields of tanzania, poets & playwrights, africa.
